title.zh: 在阿尔拜省设立两所急诊医院，一所位于Guinobatan市镇，另一所位于Oas市镇，并授权为此拨款的法案
title.en: An Act Establishing Two Emergency Hospitals in the Province of Albay, One in the Municipality of Guinobatan and the Other in the Municipality of Oas, and Authorizing the Appropriation of Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Establishing Two Emergency Hospitals in the Province of Albay, One in the Municipality of Guinobatan and the Other in the Municipality of Oas, and Authorizing the Appropriation of Funds Therefor

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1972/ra_6571_1972.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: There shall be established, under the direct supervision of the Director of Medical Services, two emergency hospitals in the Province of Albay, one in the Municipality of Guinobatan and the other in the Municipality of Oas.

The sum of five hundred thousand pesos is hereby authorized to be appropriated, out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated, for the establishment, operation and maintenance of these hospitals during the fiscal year nineteen hundred seventy one at two hundred fifty thousand pesos each. Thereafter, such sums as may be needed for their operation and maintenance shall be included in the annual General appropriations Act.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Enacted without Executive approval, September 30, 1972.
